column1: # mixed category (authored_v3). Guideline v1.1. Fields: LABEL SURGERY TAGS SCENARIOS TEXT

column5: Knee is stiff in the mornings but loosens up after a few heel slides. Got to 95 degrees bend today, is that ok for week 3?
ankle puffs up a bit by evening, gone by morning with leg up on pillows. when can i switch from walker to stick?
Bruise on my thigh is turning yellow now and fading. Also can I shower without the plastic cover yet?
There's a little click in the knee when I go up stairs, doesn't hurt at all. How many sets of heel slides should I be doing now?
Temp was 37.3 this evening, feeling fine otherwise. What time is my staple removal on Monday, the letter got lost
Doctor sir, knee is feeling tight like a band around it but walking 200 metres now. Kindly tell when to start static cycling.
Sleeping badly and feeling a bit down, but talking to my daughter helps. Can I sleep on my operated side yet, it's week 5
pain abt 3/10 most of day, bit more after physio then settles. can i stop the tramadol and just use paracetamol?
Writing for my mum (hip done 2 weeks ago). She managed the stairs with one crutch today, some soreness after that settled with rest. Is the raised toilet seat still needed?
Knee sore after physio, settles in an hour with ice. No calf pain, no fever. Walked to the end of the road and back!
Numb patch on the outer side of the scar is the same as it has been since surgery. Otherwise just stiff. Will the feeling come back?
6 weeks today. 110 degrees bend, walking without the stick indoors, only a mild ache at night. Physio happy. When is the next x-ray?
Hip is having mild pain only, 2-3 out of 10, tablets are working. My son is asking can I travel by car to Pune, 3 hours journey
bruisin on my thigh is going green n yellow, looks better than last wk. how long b4 i can drive
Checked temp 98.9F, feels normal. Leg up most of the afternoon and the ankle swelling has gone down. Should I keep the stockings on at night?
Feeling frustrated that progress is slow but I'm keeping up the exercises. Groin is a bit stiff first thing. How long until I can put my own socks on?
Healed scar itches like mad at night now, no redness, it's fully closed. Is bio-oil ok to use?
Tiny spot of blood on the new dressing this morning, hasn't got any bigger since. Can I still go to my physio at 2?
Can't fully straighten the knee yet, about 5 degrees off. Sore after exercises but fine by evening. Any tips for the straightening exercise?
Papa had his knee done 10 days back. Small bruise at the injection site on tummy, otherwise he is walking with walker inside house. What protein foods to give?
Loose end of a stitch sticking out of the scar, no redness or ooze and it doesn't pull. Leave it for the nurse on Thursday?
I walked 1 km today, the knee ached afterwards but settled with ice and the leg up. Should I do that daily or every other day?
hip ok, bit sore when i get out of the chair but it goes. using the reacher for everythin lol. when can i bend to tie shoes
Temp 37.6 after my nap, no other problems. Is it ok to take paracetamol and ibuprofen together?
Ankle and foot swell by the evening but next morning they're back to normal after sleeping with the leg raised. Could I fly to see my sister at 6 weeks?
Knee is having tightness only, no other issue. Physio is making me do 20 quad sets, is that too much? Kindly advise.
No chills, no calf pain, scar looks dry and clean. Just wanted to ask how long I need the blood thinner injections.
Week 8 after hip: walking 30 mins outdoors with a cane, mild ache at the end. Can I go back to my desk job part time?
Bit teary some evenings and sleep is broken, but I'm managing and getting out in the garden. Is it normal to feel low after a joint replacement?
Clicking in the new knee when I bend it, no pain and no swelling with it. Also my bend is stuck at 90, should I push harder?
Bowels are back to normal after the lactulose, went today. When should I stop the stool softener?
My husband is 3 weeks post hip. Bruising down his thigh is fading and he's sleeping better. Can he sit in the front seat for a short car trip?
pain scor 4 today same as yday, tabs keep it ok. how much water shud i drink a day
Physio said the warmth in the knee after exercise is normal and it's the same as last week. Bend is 105 now. Ok to start the exercise bike?
Stiff after sitting through a long film but it eases once I walk around. Any stretches for the evenings?
Operation side thigh is little sore after walking, settles after rest. When I can sit cross-legged on floor for pooja?
The A&E doctor checked my calf on Sunday and the scan was clear, it feels fine now. Do I still keep wearing the stockings?
Sleeping poorly because I can't get comfy with the knee, otherwise doing okay. Can I put a pillow under it at night?
temp 99.5 F after a hot shower, back to 98.6 now. dressing dry. when can i get the wound wet properly
Got up the full flight of stairs at home today, good leg first! A bit achy in the hip afterwards but gone after a cup of tea.
Mum's knee: she does her exercises 3 times a day and the ankle swelling goes down overnight. She wants to know if she can kneel to pray yet.
Pinkish scar line is fading nicely, no discharge. Mild ache when the weather changes. Should I massage the scar?
Weight is increasing since surgery as I am sitting at home only. Pain is less now. What diet to follow, I am diabetic.
Hip feels a bit tight at the front when I stand up, loosens after a few steps. Is swimming allowed at 10 weeks?
Nurse said the pink damp patch on the dressing was normal drainage. Still just a little damp and no bigger. When's the next dressing change?
Temp 37.8 tonight, no other problems. Is it ok to take paracetamol and ibuprofen together?
Knee is stiff in the mornings but I'm at 90 degrees. The bottom of the scar looks a bit red and warm though, is that normal?
Having fever 100.6 since evening, wound looks ok. Walking with walker in house. What to do now?
Clear watery fluid coming from the top of the incision, dressing a bit wet. Otherwise walking well with crutches. Do I change the dressing myself?
staples feel like theyre pulling when i bend, skin a bit puckered round one. physio going ok tho, 100 deg
My knee pain has been getting worse every day this week even with the tablets. Exercises are harder. Is this normal at 3 weeks?
Feeling sick after every dose of the pain tablets, only managed toast today. Wound looks fine and I'm walking around the house.
Motion not passed from 4 days, stomach is tight. Knee is better, walking slowly. Kindly advise.
Got a bit dizzy standing up from the sofa twice today. Otherwise the hip is healing nicely. Should I be worried?
Itchy red rash on my arms since starting the new antibiotic, no swelling of the face and breathing is fine. Also when do I see the surgeon?
Forgot last night's blood thinner tablet, only realised this morning. Do I take two today? Leg feels fine.
Knee clunks when I come down stairs and it hurts when it does. Feels like it might give way. Rest of recovery has been good.
My dad hasn't slept properly for 4 nights and is barely eating, very flat in himself. Says he doesn't want to do the exercises. Wound is fine.
Leg swelling has got worse over the last two weeks but it goes down overnight with the leg raised. No calf pain. Started walking outside.
Knee is still swollen and sore. Can I start using the exercise bike?
38.2 this afternoon, otherwise I feel ok and ate lunch fine. Is a temperature normal on day 6?
Feeling a bit feverish tonight, didn't check the temperature. Scar looks the same. Walked twice round the garden.
pain in hip is not controled even after the tabs, 7/10 most of the day. otherwise moving ok w walker
Knee is paining more and more since 3 days, tablets giving relief only for 1 hour. Doing exercises as told. What to do?
Small gap at the bottom end of the scar where a scab came off, it's dry, no pus. Should I just cover it? Otherwise feeling good.
Dressing ooze has spread from a small spot to most of the pad since yesterday. It's blood-coloured but not soaked through. Physio tomorrow still ok?
Had a nosebleed this morning that stopped after ten minutes. I'm on the blood thinner. Hip otherwise fine.
I slipped in the bathroom yesterday and landed on my bottom. Walking same as before with the frame, no new pain. Just letting you know.
Numb tingly area next to the scar seems bigger than last week. Bend is 100 degrees now, physio pleased.
Threw up once after the morning tablets, kept lunch down. Wound is dry. Should I take the tablets with food?
temp 101 F with the wound looking fine, no chills. Can I still go to the outpatient physio class?
Temperature 38.4 this evening. Ankle swelling goes down with the leg up as usual. Do I need to come in?
Hip is a little red and warm around the incision, no discharge. Walking fine. Also, is the toilet seat raiser still needed at week 4?
Pink fluid on the dressing again this morning, about the size of a coin. Got the exercises done though.
My mother's knee is paining a lot at night, she is crying, painkillers not helping much. During day she is walking with walker. Please advise.
No poo for 3 days now even with the softener, feeling bloated. Pain is ok and the stairs went well.
Ran out of my blood thinner injections yesterday and the pharmacy is closed till Monday. Feeling fine, knee doing well.
Stitches at the top of the hip scar are irritated and catching on my clothes. Bruising has faded and I'm managing stairs.
Feel woozy and dizzy since they increased the oxycodone. Pain much better though. Should I cut back?
Walking is going well, 500 m today. But the knee keeps feeling loose like it might buckle, and it's swollen afterwards.
Writing for my grandmother: she was 37.9 this morning, otherwise eating and walking to the bathroom with help. Do we need to bring her in?
Feeling really low for the past week, crying a lot and not sleeping, can't face the exercises. No thoughts of hurting myself. The wound is healing well.
Swelling round my knee is worse this week than last, but goes down when I lie with it up. No calf pain. Bend is 95.
Scar is little warm and swollen at one place, no pus. Today I walked till the gate. Should I put ice?
temprature 37.9 C, feel ok otherwise. need to know when stitches come out
My hip pain is a bit worse every day for the last week, now needing tablets before every walk. Can I go back on the stronger ones?
Something about the scar is bothering me, it just looks different to yesterday though I can't say how. Otherwise I'm on track with exercises.
Had a fall on the stairs, caught myself on the rail, knee feels the same and I can still walk on it. Is there anything I should look out for?
Feeling nauseous most afternoons. Otherwise the leg is better and the bruise is fading. Is it the antibiotics?
hip swolen n achy today. also when can i lie on my side
Pain about 6/10 and creeping up each day, despite taking everything on time. Bend has gone backwards from 100 to 90.
Mum took her rivaroxaban twice by mistake this morning, she seems fine. Her knee is doing well and she's walking with a stick.
Sore knee after physio which settles, but there's clear fluid seeping from one staple hole since this morning.
Fever 38 hai since morning, wound clean. Walking with stick. Should I take crocin?
Ankle swelling is fine with the leg up, but the skin along the scar has gone a bit pink and hot today. Physio says carry on with bending.
knee hurts today. what time is physio tmrw
Exercises going well, bend at 100. My right calf has been hot and tender since yesterday though, not near the wound.
Ankle and foot swell by the evening and stay just as big in the morning even after sleeping with the leg raised. Could I fly at 6 weeks?
Thick yellow stuff coming out of the incision and it smells bad. Walking ok with crutches. Do I change the dressing myself?
temp 101.5 F with the wound looking fine, no chills. Can I still go to the physio class?
Temperature 38.5 this evening. Ankle swelling goes down with the leg up as usual. Do I need to come in?
Doing well at 3 weeks, walking with a stick. Bent down to pick up the remote, heard a pop and now can't put weight on the leg, it looks shorter.
Scar looks great and I'm walking further every day. Just puffed on the stairs today, which is new, and it hasn't eased after sitting down for 20 minutes.
Quick update: stairs going well. Also had a sharp pain in my chest when I breathe in, started this afternoon. Should I mention it at physio?
Doctor sir knee is better, walking 300 steps. But since yesterday motion is coming black colour, I am on blood thinner. Kindly advise.
Exercises done, ice on. The toes on that foot have gone cold and pale and I can't really wiggle them.
Mum's hip is healing nicely but tonight she's confused, doesn't know what day it is and keeps asking for people who aren't there.
Bruise on my thigh is fading. Also my urine has gone pinky-red today and I haven't eaten beetroot. On apixaban.
Shaking chills on and off all afternoon, temp 38.1, and the wound is a bit red. Is it just the weather?
Started the new antibiotic this morning. Pain is fine. My lips have swollen up and my throat feels tight.
knee doin ok, bend 95. but calf is rock hard n really sore since this morn, not the scar bit
Physio went well today. Blood is coming through the dressing and has soaked the pad and my trousers, it won't stop.
The bottom of the scar has opened up and I can see a gap with something deeper underneath. Otherwise feeling fine, eating well.
Having fever 39 since last night and shivering also. Wound is little red. What to do now?
Redness around the scar was a small patch this morning and now it's spread halfway up my thigh. Exercises done though.
Dad's recovery has been slow but steady. He fell in the hallway this evening and now can't stand on the operated leg at all.
Stiff and sore as usual, nothing new really. Nearly fainted in the kitchen this morning, heart racing and I couldn't catch my breath.
Pain is completely out of control tonight, way worse than anything since surgery, the whole leg is tight and hard and the morphine hasn't touched it.
Mood has been really low and honestly some days I don't want to be here anymore. Knee is healing fine.
Hit my head on the cupboard door, I'm on the blood thinner injections. Feel ok and the hip is fine, just thought I'd mention it.
Swelling in my lower leg is worse this week and stays the same even when I keep it up all night. Calf aches a bit too.
